chunks: From him, from Jaʿfar ibn Muthannā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān al-Rawwāsī, from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “When the sun passes the zenith, then perform eight rakʿahs, then perform the obligatory prayer as four rakʿahs. Then, when you have finished your supererogatory prayer, whether you shortened it or lengthened it, perform the ʿAṣr prayer.”

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, marking the beginning of the noon prayer time

ai.seo_question: What should be prayed after the sun passes the zenith according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives instruction regarding the prayer schedule after the sun passes the zenith, mentioning the eight rakʿahs before the obligatory noon prayer and then the ʿAṣr prayer afterward. It reflects jurisprudential guidance on the order and timing of recommended and obligatory salat.
